text:
ops-bot: Release train bulletin — temporary freeze extension for APAC region due to capacity pressure in ap-northeast-1. Freeze now extended by 4 hours from original window. See quick notes below. :rotating_light:

anna: Heads up all — extending the quiet window for the release train in APAC. New freeze end: 2024-11-25T22:00:00Z. This is to allow the nightly maintenance + node reprovisioning to finish. Please hold non-critical merges and feature flags.

devon: Quick Q — are security hotpatches allowed during this extension?

anna: Yes, security/urgent bug fixes are allowed, but they must follow the emergency rollout flow: add label `urgent-hotfix`, open a PR with the template, and ping @oncall + me. We'll schedule a 30m canary slot and prioritize rollout.

liam: Will this impact Dedicated customers on reserved pools? Any changes to capacity reservations?

anna: No change to reserved capacity SLAs. This is a control-plane/deploy window freeze only — reserved pools continue serving. If you operate a Dedicated rollout, coordinate with infra to avoid overlapping node reprovs.

jess: SRE note — we saw autoscaler jitter start at 20:06 UTC, mitigations in place: temporarily routed traffic from ap-northeast-1 to eu-west-1 for non-latency sensitive routes. Watching queues. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/rollouts/apac-capacity

devon: For the emergency flow, what does the canary tag look like? Any CLI snippet?

anna: Use the release CLI: `rw release start --canary-tag urgent --window 30m --override-freeze` and include `--approvers anna,oncall`. Ops will run a quick smoke set. Add your PR link in the thread.

liam: I'll update the console deploy tooltip to mention the extension and the emergency flow.

jess: FYI team — if you need to trigger a manual fallback routing, run:
```
kubectl annotate svc redwood-primary rollout=force-fallback --namespace infra
```
I'll document the full steps in the playbook.

anna: Thanks — I'll post a short postmortem stub if the reprovision completes slower than expected. For now: hold non-urgent merges to main for APAC services, label hotfixes properly, and ping here for approvals. :thumbsup:

oncall: Acknowledged. I'll standby for approval pings and track any hotfix rollouts in the release board.

liam: :+1: thanks all, updating docs now.
